title: "Saucer Again Is Reported Over Tacoma" - newspaper clipping, June 1954
description: Newspaper clipping headlined "Saucer Again Is Reported Over Tacoma," reporting that at least seven persons watched an orange ball appear at midnight Monday, then shrink and disappear. A Tacoma transit driver and passengers saw the glow and called McChord Air Force Base, whose tower could not locate the phenomenon; the object "shrunk to the size of a grapefruit, then to the size of an orange, and disappeared," estimated at about 1,000 feet in the air. The page carries FBI file number 100-18945-54 and a JUN 18 1954 stamp.
